description: Conventional Commits specification for git commit messages

examples: feat(api): add endpoint for recurring plans
fix: prevent modal from closing on backdrop click
docs: update README with deployment instructions

style.description: Changes that do not affect the meaning of the code (white-space, formatting, missing semi-colons, etc)

refactor.description: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
examples: refactor(services): extract SCD Type 2 logic to service

perf.description: A code change that improves performance
examples: perf: reduce modal open time from 5s to 1s

test.description: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
examples: test: add integration tests for transfer endpoints
test(unit): cover edge cases in article service

build.description: Changes that affect the build system or external dependencies

ci.description: Changes to CI configuration files and scripts

chore.description: Other changes that don't modify src or test files
examples: chore: clean up old migration files

format.type: Required. One of: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore
format.scope: Optional. Module or component affected (api, bot, frontend, db, etc.)
format.subject: Required. Short (50 chars max) description in imperative mood
format.body: Optional. Longer description with context and motivation
format.footer: Optional. Breaking changes, issue references, co-authors
